_comment: Web-verified people, brands, events and nicknames, read by check_raw_facts.py: a word in
any `name` here is not listed for review again. Same rule as agency_roster.json: add an
entry only with a source URL, never from the corpus's own majority spelling (`Shamsuri`
outnumbered `Samsuri` 41 to 3 and was wrong). Government bodies go in agency_roster.json.
